messages:
Sarah Myers: Quick sync — we're getting a partner request from AcmeHW + CloudX to bundle an open model into their marketplace image. Need to lock down origin attestation + redistribution terms before we sign off.
Mike Lee: 👍 which model variant are they asking for? FP16 quant or 8-bit?
Sarah Myers: They want an 8-bit quantized runtime-friendly variant plus a non-quantized reference for gov/reg review. Also asking for a signed provenance file and checksum.
Anya Patel: Put legal on it — potential export control / rehost clauses. We need to confirm the license allows redistribution in a marketplace bundle.
LegalBot: Heads up: many open checkpoints have "no commercial redistribution" or "non-derivative" clauses. We need a written copy of the upstream license + confirmation of model weights source. If they want to redistribute, we need an explicit grant or use a model with a permissive license (MIT/Apache-style).
Leo Chen: Tech checklist idea:
```
- model artifact (weights.tar.gz)
- provenance.json (sha256, origin_url, date)
- runtime-compat matrix (cuda, a100, t4)
- quantization profile (8-bit config)
- inference-compat test vector
- container image or OCI artifact
```
Sarah Myers: Also need to decide how we present it in the CloudX marketplace listing: is Redwood a co-signer on the listing or just providing the model and an integration guide?
Mike Lee: Redwood should be listed as "Verified model provider" and we should require that any marketplace bundle includes the provenance.json. That protects us if downstreams rehost incorrectly.
Anya Patel: For announcements: don't promise support beyond the integration guide. If AcmeHW wants joint press, Legal needs to sign off on copy. embargo window?
LegalBot: Request: submit the proposed announcement draft and any claim language. We will flag IP/attribution and export language. Also check if model weights include any 3rd-party data restrictions.
Sarah Myers: Proposed timeline:
- Wed: legal confirms redistribution permissibility
- Fri: tech team generates signed provenance + packaging
- Next Tue: internal review + announcement draft ready
Mike Lee: Ops note — if we provide quantized artifact, include a labeled fallback to the full model in the private S3 (customer-managed) so enterprises can pull non-quantized for audits.
Leo Chen: Also want a small automated test harness included in the bundle: one API call + expected hash of output for a fixed prompt. Helps CloudX verify runtime integrity.
Sarah Myers: Good. I'll draft a minimal announcement skeleton and the packaging spec. @LegalBot can you confirm shareable/license checklist?
LegalBot: On it. Please attach the upstream license text and a checksum of the weights. I'll return comments by EOD Wed.
Anya Patel: One more ask from GTM — pricing/sku mapping for Marketplace: will this be a free model image, paid integration, or revenue share? We need that to map to sales hooks.
Sarah Myers: GTM wants optional paid support. For now we'll aim for a free listing + paid professional services. We'll confirm revenue share after legal OK.
Mike Lee: Minor: include a short security note in the listing about recommended network isolation and keys for private deployments.
Sarah Myers: Perfect. I'll upload the draft spec here by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
